detail.longDescription: A tool result your agent reads once gets billed again on every model call after it. A new paper builds six denial-of-wallet attacks on that: one session's cumulative input reached 14,293x its first call. Of 3,830 MCP server repos scanned, 71 had any code-visible safeguard. https:// arxiv.org/abs/2609.28585 Cap context growth and spend on the host. And if you want to watch a long agent run from your phone and Ctrl-C it, that is what we built https:// shell.online # AIAgents # MCP # AI
